Trace, implement and test: leetcode1104 path in zigzag labelled binary tree sol3 using log2

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include<vector>
#include<algorithm>
#include<iostream>
#include<bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    vector<int> pathInZigZagTree(int label) {
        int levelIdx;
        int start, end; // 用来记录当前层的第1个和最后1个结点的值
        vector<int> res;        
        levelIdx = log2(label);
        start = 1 << levelIdx;
        end = (1 << (levelIdx + 1)) - 1;
        int pos, dir;        
        dir = levelIdx & 0x01; // levelIdx是奇数时 dir = 1(从右到左), 否则是0(从左到右)
        pos = dir ? label - start : end - label;        
        while (levelIdx)
        {
            start = 1 << levelIdx;
            end = (1 << (levelIdx + 1)) - 1;
            
            if (dir) res.push_back(start + pos);
            else res.push_back(end - pos);
            
            dir = 1 - dir; // 翻转: 0 => 1 或 1 => 0
            pos >>= 1;
            levelIdx--;
        }        
        res.push_back(1);        
        reverse(res.begin(), res.end());        
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    auto res = sol.pathInZigZagTree(12);
    for (auto x : res)
        cout << x << " ";

    return 0;
}
